Methemoglobinemia, commonly referred to as Blue
Baby Syndrome, is primarily caused by the

form methemoglobin. This form of hemoglobin

impaired oxygen delivery to tissues, resulting in
symptoms such as cyanotic skin discoloration,
shortness of breath, and potential asphyxiation.

questions.question_english: A senior teacher is undergoing the penalty of withholding of promotion for three years. However, a junior teacher in the same seniority list is promoted during this period. The senior teacher files a grievance claiming his junior superseding him violates natural justice. How should the Directorate respond based on CCS (CCA) Rules?
options_english: The grievance is invalid, as promoting a junior is a direct outcome of the senior’s penalty.

The Directorate must promote the senior to the higher post but withhold the corresponding pay scale.

questions.explanation_english: When a senior employee is undergoing the penalty of withholding of promotion, they cannot be promoted during the penalty period. questions.question_english: In the transition from paper-based to digital record-keeping, the principle of 'Data Redundancy' pertains to:
options_english: The unnecessary hiring and duplication of clerical and administrative staff positions
Storing identical data across multiple locations to prevent loss from system failure.
The automated system-wide deletion of administrative files older than one academic year
The high-level cryptographic encryption of sensitive data to prevent unauthorized breach
questions.explanation_english: The correct answer is 'Storing identical data across multiple locations to prevent loss from system failure.' Data redundancy in digital record systems involves storing duplicate data copies across distinct physical or cloud storage locations to guard against unexpected hardware failure or data corruption. Maintaining redundant administrative backups ensures business continuity, high data availability, and rapid system recovery during operational disruptions. Planned redundancy protects critical institutional databases without creating chaotic, unmanaged duplicate entries across active administrative portals. The other options do not accurately describe the principle of data redundancy; hiring additional staff or deleting old files does not relate to the concept of redundancy in data management.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (b) है। डेटा पुनरावृत्ति का सिद्धांत डिजिटल रिकॉर्ड सिस्टम में कई स्थानों पर समान डेटा को संग्रहीत करना है ताकि सिस्टम विफलता से नुकसान को रोका जा सके। डेटा पुनरावृत्ति का अर्थ है कि डेटा की प्रतियां भौतिक या क्लाउड स्टोरेज स्थानों में संग्रहीत की जाती हैं ताकि हार्डवेयर विफलता या डेटा भ्रष्टाचार के कारण होने वाले नुकसान से बचा जा सके। प्रशासनिक बैकअप को बनाए रखना व्यवसाय की निरंतरता, उच्च डेटा उपलब्धता और संचालन में व्यवधान के दौरान त्वरित प्रणाली पुनर्प्राप्ति सुनिश्चित करता है। अन्य विकल्प डेटा पुनरावृत्ति के सिद्धांत का सही वर्णन नहीं करते हैं।
